geometry_access_audit.scope: Recorded MCP tool names, geometry filenames in read arguments, and geometry references in native command text; indirect paths, external scripts, historical memory and unlogged execution are not covered

notes: The historical DA3 smoke is interrupted and excluded from the 160 valid No task progress episodes.
DA3 only replaces depth for back_project_batch and query_world_map.
NoContactGT removes contact-derived feedback; other progress, geometry, success, scoring-source access and historical memory remain.

NoGeomTools removes back_project_batch and query_world_map from registered tools and their prompt instructions; internal depth/world maps, task-progress distances, contact, success, file permissions and historical memory remain.

E06 No task progress and agent success builds on No task progress, hides live success/termination/progress and removes native-success VLA early stopping. The independent evaluator scores the final state after the planner returns; geometry, contact and historical memory remain. Agent declarations are not benchmark scores.

E07 removes historical task/global memory only; current-episode history and baseline feedback remain. Its 41/160 score happens to match E03, a separate setting. Task/seed matching is not proof of identical scenes or causal attribution.

E08 combines geometry-query, historical-memory, progress and contact-feedback removal and blocks scoring-source access. Native success, robot proprioception and controls remain; internal depth/world maps and camera metadata remain saved. It is not an all-ground-truth-free or OS-isolated system.
